title: Escalation after Company-Nawabi conflict
detail: The breakdown between the Company and Mir Qasim widened into a larger regional conflict involving Awadh and the Mughal emperor.

title: Battle of Buxar
detail: Company forces defeated the allied army, establishing superior military leverage in north and eastern India.

title: Path opened to fiscal-constitutional control
detail: The military outcome enabled negotiations and arrangements that culminated in Company revenue rights in Bengal.
